checks: Migration installs twice on PostgreSQL without deleting history.
Unknown AC power produces no routine history; the ESP32 heartbeat remains online.
AC OFF suppresses samples while ping delivery and acknowledgement still complete.
AC ON saves a timestamped profile snapshot without inventing physical power, temperature or battery.
A newer physical-remote OFF state stops routine recording and remains available to Realtime.
A newer physical-remote ON state resumes recording automatically.
A fresh fan-only frame does not make its older OFF power field override a newer ON setting.
Invalid future field timestamps fall back to the capture time, matching the live UI power selection.
Existing profiles bound by database ID, stable ESP32 ID or saved controller name retain ON recording.
A sleeping ESP32 stores its sleep announcement without generating routine readings.
An OFF command still completes its IR dispatch audit, without adding an analytics sample.
RPC reinstall and anonymous credential-scoped access preserve OFF suppression and token checks.
Per-field timestamp precedence is consistent, and existing ON history survives subsequent OFF changes.
